vacancies.title: Electrical/Functional AIT Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Engineering-heavy AIT but predominantly electrical/functional.

vacancies.title: PA and Safety Support Engineer
vacancies.assessment: ESA ESTEC product assurance and safety support, with a high requirement of 10 years space-sector experience and 5 years PA/QA.

vacancies.title: Mechanical Technician
vacancies.assessment: Excellent ESTEC hardware proximity but significant under-leveling for an MSc engineer.

vacancies.title: E2E Performance Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Deadline extended to 23 October 2026 and application active on official ATG page. Direct ESTEC end-to-end performance simulations, V&V and software reviews; strong optical/software requirements are a technical stretch.

vacancies.title: Laboratory Coordinator (Life, Physical Sciences and Life Support)
vacancies.assessment: Relevant ESTEC test-facility role; dedicated lab instrumentation experience is the main stretch.

vacancies.title: Configuration and Data Management Support
vacancies.assessment: Application deadline passed on 23 September 2026.

vacancies.title: Design & Manufacturing Development Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Noordwijk composite spacecraft structures design and manufacturing; strong mechanical engineering fit with specialist composites experience as a stretch.

vacancies.title: Design & Analysis Engineer
vacancies.assessment: ATG CompositesLab structures CAD and FEM engineering in Noordwijk, with composite analysis expertise a stretch.

vacancies.title: Quality and Knowledge Management Officer
vacancies.assessment: Noordwijk ATG headquarters internal QMS, compliance, contract audits and knowledge management. Requires 8+ years dedicated quality experience and ISO9001 auditing; not space hardware or direct ESTEC. Stretch/low priority.

vacancies.title: Materials Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESA/ESTEC TEC support on structures, mechanisms and materials: hardware design/manufacturing/test reviews, shadow engineering, failure/NCR investigations and mechanical R&D. Strong MSc mechanical and hardware fit, but mandatory 5+ years relevant work, solid space-sector experience and thorough ECSS management/knowledge-management background make it a stretch. No salary stated.

vacancies.title: IVV Engineer for IRIS²
vacancies.location: Noordwijk, Netherlands / Arganda del Rey, Madrid, Spain (location contradictory: Madrid on-site presence explicitly required)
vacancies.assessment: Integration, verification and validation for IRIS² ground segment hardware/software; ECSS, system test planning and qualification. MSc related engineering and 3 years space IVV required; stretch on sector-specific experience. Employer lists Noordwijk as selectable work location, but job description explicitly requires relocation/on-site work in Madrid. Confirm actual Netherlands option before applying. No confirmed ESTEC placement.

vacancies.title: Mechanical Test Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESTEC test-centre mechanical design and test-facility engineering; excellent match.

vacancies.title: Mechanical Test Technician
vacancies.assessment: ESTEC testing and calibration, technician-level role below MSc engineering seniority.

vacancies.title: Mechanisms Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Strong ESTEC match. Requires MSc and seven years in space mechanisms or other complex mechanical systems. Experience with complex machine design and thermal switch mechanisms relevant. Space tribology and pyrotechnic experience are stretch areas. Salary and deadline not published.

vacancies.title: Ground Segment System Engineer for IRIS²
vacancies.assessment: Hybrid role with Noordwijk option. Requires 5 years in satellite ground segment, mission control or network management. Specialized stretch; no confirmed ESTEC placement.

vacancies.title: Ground Segment IVV Engineer for IRIS²
vacancies.assessment: Updated posting of IVV Engineer for IRIS²; hybrid Noordwijk/Madrid options, no explicit relocation mandate on revised listing; 3 years space IVV requested; ESTEC placement not confirmed.

vacancies.title: Project/Procurement Manager for IRIS²
vacancies.location: Noordwijk, Netherlands / Arganda del Rey, Madrid, Spain (hybrid; ESTEC placement unconfirmed)
vacancies.assessment: Senior/stretch; minimum 10 years relevant work experience plus project and subcontract/contract management in space/ground HW/SW. Noordwijk or Madrid hybrid possible, no confirmed ESTEC placement. Potential project-management career direction but limited direct procurement experience.

vacancies.title: System Engineer for IRIS²
vacancies.assessment: Satellite system engineering at ESA ESTEC or Madrid. Senior stretch; ten years specialist satellite experience required. Deadline 23 October 2026.

vacancies.title: Platform Engineer for IRIS²
vacancies.location: Arganda del Rey (Madrid), Spain or Noordwijk, Netherlands (text offers both; job listing displays Madrid)
vacancies.assessment: Potential Noordwijk placement but listing defaults to Madrid; 10 years specialist satellite platform procurement/manufacturing/operations and large ESA projects required. Significant senior stretch despite transferable mechanical engineering and manufacturing background.
